content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge does not permit retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review. Resubmitting would not cure the authorization defect, while a formal appeal is allowed and has paid 4 of 20 similar claims versus 0 of 5 for clean resubmission; therefore the remaining payer remedy should be pursued before considering patient liability.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
